target.statement: Average classification accuracy of CF-JEPA on the UCR 126 benchmark (0.819 ± 0.001) using adaptive average pooling and linear SVM.
target.dataset: UCR Time Series Classification Archive (126 datasets)

compute.basis: Pretraining on 126 UCR datasets for 100 epochs each with 3 seeds, plus SVM evaluation with 5-fold CV, is estimated to take ~10 hours on 8 CPU cores; no GPU required but would speed up training.

blockers: No code available (repository not yet public)
Requires reimplementing the full CF-JEPA method from paper description
Large number of datasets (126) and seeds (3) increase runtime
title: CF-JEPA: Mask-free forward prediction with asymmetric encoder utilization for time-series representation learning
